ordered_operations: reveal three Islands, a Mountain, and Twinflame from the actual library
enumerate all legal unordered splits in the rules layer
ask the bound frozen provider for the minimizing split and caster pile
verify the selected record carries the provider evaluator ID and SHA-256
move the chosen pile to hand and the other pile to graveyard
replay the recorded choices without policy code
preconditions: The scenario is constructed with build_exact_game().
The contextual_combo_v1 evaluator ID and SHA-256 are bound before the choice.
Three Islands are already controlled on Turn 3, Dualcaster Mage is in hand, and the mana pool is explicitly funded for the test cast.
required_assertions: the choice record contains the exact bound evaluator ID and 64-character SHA-256
all five revealed physical cards end in exactly one of hand or graveyard
the unchosen pile may be empty; any cards in it move to graveyard
fresh replay reproduces the complete recorded selection
the transcript does not invent a Sol Ring or MANA_PRODUCED event absent from the named test

plain_english: The exact frozen deck is placed in a Turn 3 fixture with three Islands on the battlefield, Dualcaster Mage in hand, and an explicitly funded legal mana pool; the fixture does not use Sol Ring.
Fact or Fiction reveals three Islands, a Mountain, and Twinflame, and the resulting choice record is explicitly bound to the frozen contextual evaluator ID and SHA-256.
Twinflame reaches hand, every revealed physical card reaches hand or graveyard, and fresh replay reproduces the complete recorded choice without rerunning policy code.
title: Fact or Fiction binds its contextual evaluator, moves both piles, and replays the exact choice
